businessActivity2021.label: Business activity supported by Shopify merchants (2021 study)
businessActivity2021.definition: Deloitte: 'Business Activity represents the impact on the gross output and is interpreted as the value of economic transactions throughout supply chains associated with production of goods and services'; direct, indirect and induced impacts of Shopify merchants' sales, gross (not incremental) impacts, from an input-output model.

jobs2021.label: Jobs supported by Shopify merchants (2021 study)
jobs2021.definition: Deloitte 'Job impact': 'Employment represents the number of persons engaged in producing output for final goods and services. In the case of the six countries (Argentina, Brazil, Canada, Israel, Mexico and the United States) employment represents the number of jobs.' Includes direct, indirect and induced jobs; figures rounded.

economicActivity.label: Economic activity of Shopify's ecosystem
economicActivity.period: year ending June 30, 2026 (The Entrepreneur Effect, published October 2026; the newest edition)
economicActivity.definition: Shopify: 'Economic activity includes the direct, indirect, and induced effects of merchant sales and partner activity', estimated 'with an input-output framework using merchant sales, partner revenue, and OECD global supply-chain data' (Shopify Economic Impact Summary). A modelled estimate, not reported sales. The report does not state how merchants are assigned to states.

jobsSupported.label: Jobs supported by Shopify's ecosystem
jobsSupported.period: year ending June 30, 2026 (The Entrepreneur Effect, published October 2026; the newest edition)
jobsSupported.definition: Shopify: 'Jobs supported estimates the number of people engaged in direct, indirect, and induced business activity across Shopify's ecosystem and related supply chains.' Printed rounded (e.g. '12K', '2.3M').

notes: Two editions, kept under separate metric keys so they are never mixed. The newest is Shopify's own 'The Entrepreneur Effect' (published October 2026; figures for the year ending June 30, 2026; tier company-published; no outside modeller named). It supplies all 50 state rows (no DC row; its 'Territories/Other' row, $5.5B and 19K, is not mapped) and a nine-market country table (Australia, Canada, France, Germany, Italy, Japan, Spain, United Kingdom, United States), whose rows replace the Deloitte 2021 rows for those nine countries. The other eight countries (Mexico, China, Hong Kong, India, Singapore, Netherlands, Sweden, New Zealand) and the EU keep Deloitte's 'Global Economic Impact Study of Shopify, 2021 Refresh' (Shopify engaged Deloitte; tier company-commissioned), the PDF Shopify attaches to its April 28, 2022 newsroom release; no newer edition with figures for those countries was found (checked 2026-11-24). The EU region is a 2021 Deloitte aggregate: under its own metric it overlaps only the Netherlands and Sweden rows (France, Germany, Italy and Spain now sit under the 2026 metric), and it is not a sum of either. The two editions use different definitions (Deloitte's merchant-only business activity vs Shopify's ecosystem economic activity including partners), so their figures are not comparable. The May 2023 Shopify Entrepreneurship Index (2022 data) pages (shopify.com/media/index-beta) returned 404 in the earlier pass and are not used. Values printed as $…M (AK, ND, WV) are stored in billions (e.g. $583M = 0.583); jobs printed as '12K' or '2.3M' are stored as 12000 or 2300000. All figures are modelled gross impacts including indirect and induced effects. The cross-border growth column is not recorded. Shopify owns no real property (FY2025 10-K Item 2) and is remote-first, so sites are only its two principal executive office addresses from the FY2025 10-K cover (the original 10-K; the 10-K/A of April 2026 does not change them); the New York address moved to 85 10th Avenue.
